findings.title: Repeated link-excerpt repair consumes the Run budget
findings.evidence: Trial 3 retries update_contact four times unsuccessfully, including URL-as-excerpt after the official page is fetched; it eventually omits the link and saves valid fields but then fails the unchanged SDK budget. Trial 1 also initially submits title/URL metadata as excerpts.
findings.recommendation: Keep the source-literal and URL gates unchanged. The reviewed description clarification is a bounded response; evaluate future runs with all failures retained and keep the 240000-token limit. Do not count the already-saved finish as a completed SDK run.
